scenes.title: The Little Cat
scenes.summary: On a movie set, actor Jean Reno throws a massive tantrum over the script, refusing to act in the absurd Christmas movie.

scenes.title: A Sinking Ship
scenes.summary: At the ASK agency, the team panics over the impending bankruptcy. Gabriel compares the agency to the Titanic sinking into freezing water.

scenes.title: A Project for Jean
scenes.summary: Mathias and Noémie present their new movie production project to Gabriel, hoping to cast Jean Reno in the leading role.

scenes.title: A New Agency
scenes.summary: Camille shares her plans to start a young talent agency with Hervé. Later, Mathias officially passes the reins of film production to Noémie.

scenes.title: A Morning Pastis
scenes.summary: At a Parisian café around 10 AM, Andréa finds movie star Jean Reno drinking pastis to clear his head. She points out his uncharacteristic heavy drinking while trying to understand why he is avoiding work.

scenes.title: The Desire to Leave
scenes.summary: Sitting at the café, Jean Reno confesses his deep weariness with modern commercial cinema and explains to Andréa his desire to retire to focus on family and nature, even as she tries to tempt him with a revolutionary role.

scenes.title: The Poisoned Offer
scenes.summary: At a café, defecting rival Élise Formain tries to recruit Gabriel to join StarMédia. Gabriel furiously refuses, calls out her obsession with imitating Andréa, and tells her in no uncertain terms where to shove her proposal.

scenes.title: A Mourning at the Agency
scenes.summary: At ASK, Gabriel and Andréa confront Mathias over lost director François Ozon and client defections. Their bitter argument is cut short when Arlette rushes in distraught with her dog Jean, only for Mathias to realize the beloved pet has died.

scenes.title: He will be here in 5 minutes
scenes.summary: Gabriel tells Arlette that the undertaker is coming.

scenes.title: The best death
scenes.summary: The vet talks to Arlette about her dog's peaceful passing.

scenes.title: Was that you
scenes.summary: Gabriel confronts Elise about a shady move regarding Sofia.

scenes.title: The budget
scenes.summary: Andrea discusses a massive movie budget problem with Mathias.

scenes.title: Waiting for Jean Reno
scenes.summary: In Andrea's office, Gabriel laments losing their last financier for Xavier Beauvois's screenplay, but their despair turns to hopeful excitement when Jean Reno agrees to visit ASK in person.

scenes.title: The Brutal Truth
scenes.summary: In her office with Jean Reno, Andrea cuts through Gabriel's polite evasions and reveals the unvarnished truth: ASK is bankrupt, the film lacks six million euros, and the agency is sinking.

scenes.title: Ready to Sink Together
scenes.summary: Touched by Andrea's fearless honesty, Jean Reno joyfully commits to starring in Xavier Beauvois's film, declaring that he is thrilled to sink with ASK just as his character did in The Big Blue.

scenes.title: Confrontation at the Supermarket
scenes.summary: In a crowded supermarket aisle, Andrea corners Elise Formain amidst family groceries, accusing her rival of manipulating producer Igor to choke off funding for Xavier Beauvois's film.

scenes.title: The Surprise Visit
scenes.summary: Colette arrives outside the ASK agency pushing baby Flora in a stroller, giving Andréa an emotional surprise and a chance to hold her daughter again.

scenes.title: A Clear-Eyed Farewell
scenes.summary: Sitting on a park bench, Andréa and Colette share an emotional, honest conversation about their future, agreeing to part ways romantically while co-parenting baby Flora.

scenes.title: The Goodbye Kiss
scenes.summary: After accepting that their romantic path has ended, Colette surprises Andréa with a tender farewell kiss, marking a peaceful and honest conclusion to their relationship.

scenes.title: A New Partnership
scenes.summary: Sitting along the Seine, Mathias and Camille discuss their future, with Mathias proposing that they launch a new talent agency together as father and daughter.

scenes.title: Gabriel's Face
scenes.summary: Andréa angrily confronts Gabriel for cutting a secret deal with rival Élise Formain, prompting Gabriel to confess that ASK is finished and he must play the villain to survive.

scenes.title: Andréa's Departure
scenes.summary: Jean Reno brings drinks to celebrate the team, but Andréa reveals she is stepping down as an agent, advising Jean on how to navigate his future career.

scenes.title: The Last Drink
scenes.summary: The agents gather to toast to their future.

scenes.title: Hé. Allez. Hey. Come
scenes.summary: Hé. Allez. Hey. Come on.

scenes.title: Turning Off the Lights
scenes.summary: Alone in the empty agency offices after the farewell gathering, Andrea and Gabriel share a tender final moment reflecting on ten years together before Gabriel turns off the lights.

scenes.title: The ASK Sign
scenes.summary: Standing outside the glass doors of ASK, Andrea and Gabriel pause with deep respect before the Samuel Kerr sign, proud of their achievements and ready to close the agency forever.

scenes.title: Last Step into the Street
scenes.summary: Stepping out onto the Parisian sidewalk under the night sky, Andrea and Gabriel share a warm embrace, promising to remain close friends as they walk forward into their new lives.
